extraFacts.fact: ASME B1.20.1 covers general-purpose inch pipe threads: NPT is a taper thread with a 60° thread form that seals on the threads, and NPSM is a straight (parallel) thread for free-fitting mechanical joints that does not seal on the thread.

NPT pipe threads to ASME B1.20.1 are 60° taper threads that seal as they are tightened, with a sealant such as PTFE tape or anti-seize paste; the threads are tapered 1 in 16 on the diameter, so wrenching them too tight can crack a cast female fitting.
extraFacts.source: ASME B1.20.1 scope and general practice for taper pipe threads

extraFacts.fact: 316L is the low-carbon grade of 316 austenitic stainless steel (carbon 0.03 % maximum), which is why it can be welded without carbide precipitation at the grain boundaries; it contains molybdenum for resistance to chloride pitting.
extraFacts.source: ASTM A240 / A276 chemical composition limits for UNS S31603
